sample-pixel-craft quality criterion (scoped expert judgment, authority proposal).
Single flat #70b9ed fill with no highlight: fixture property accepted because a roughly 2-px perpendicular stroke has no interior row for a second tone without creating 1-px noise.

Stroke built from a 1-px 45-degree core dilated to 3-px horizontal runs with 1-px pointed caps: fixture property accepted because a 2-px effective stroke is the minimum that survives 1x on navy and scales to a clean 6-device-pixel stroke at 3x nearest; 45 degrees needs no anti-aliasing so alpha stays binary.
Arm cores 3 px and 6 px (1:2) with a 90-degree vertex: owner requires asymmetry; the ratio is a fixture property.
Placement bbox [3,4,14,13], margins L3 R2 T4 B3: fixture property; half-pixel right/down bias is normal rounding for an 11x9 figure.
No outline or plate: expert acceptance; on a fixed dark panel the fill already separates (diagnostic contrast about 7.4:1), and a plate would conflict with the plate-less Start triangle.
Binary alpha: fixture property; the brief and plan permit partial alpha.
